title: The Sound of Silence
author: Katrina Goldsaito
intro: Yoshio lives in Tokyo, Japan. It is a giant, noisy, busy city full of sounds!
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide
Publisher description (Little, Brown Books for Young Readers)

questions.q: Which busy city does Yoshio live in?
questions.clue: It is a giant, noisy city in Japan.

questions.q: What is the weather like as Yoshio walks to school?
questions.clue: Drops patter on his umbrella and his boots squish in puddles.
questions.yes: It is a rainy morning as Yoshio walks to school.

questions.q: Who does Yoshio meet on his way to school?
questions.clue: She is an older woman playing a musical instrument with strings.
questions.yes: Yoshio meets a musician playing a stringed instrument called a koto.

questions.q: What does the musician say is the most beautiful sound?

options.text: The sound of ma, or silence
The sound of ocean waves crashing
The sound of birds singing songs

questions.clue: It is the quiet space when there is no noise at all.
questions.yes: The musician says the most beautiful sound is ma, or silence.

questions.q: Where does Yoshio go behind the playground to look for silence?
questions.clue: It is a quiet place filled with tall green plants.
questions.yes: Yoshio goes to the bamboo grove behind the playground.

questions.q: Why is the bamboo grove noisy instead of silent?

options.text: The wind bangs the stalks together
Dogs are barking at a squirrel
Workmen are cutting down the trees

questions.clue: The breeze makes the tall bamboo plants hit each other.
questions.yes: The wind bangs the bamboo stalks together.

questions.q: What does Yoshio hear at night while his family is sleeping?
questions.clue: Something playing music or news far away makes a low hum.
questions.yes: At night, Yoshio still hears the faint hum of a distant radio.

questions.q: When does Yoshio walk to school the next day?

options.text: Early, before anyone else is there
Late, after the lunch bell rings
At night, when the moon is out

questions.clue: He arrives at the school gates before any other pupils get there.
questions.yes: Yoshio walks to school early before anyone else arrives.

questions.q: What does Yoshio put on when he goes inside the school?
questions.clue: Japanese pupils take off their outdoor boots and wear these on the shiny floor.
questions.yes: He puts on his inside shoes and listens to them shuffle on the floor.

questions.q: What is Yoshio doing at his desk when he finally hears silence?
questions.clue: He is looking at the pages of a story he loves.
questions.yes: Yoshio is reading a story at his desk when he hears silence.

questions.q: How does Yoshio feel inside when he experiences silence?
questions.clue: Everything feels calm and still inside him, like a snowy garden.
questions.yes: Everything feels still and peaceful inside him.

questions.q: Where does Yoshio find out silence has been all along?

options.text: Only far away in the mountains
Only deep under the blue sea

questions.clue: It is right there in the tiny pauses between noises.
questions.yes: Silence is between and underneath every sound.
